long_biography.plain_text:
Scuba diving helped draw American businessman Beau Wrigley into ocean conservation. He helped originate the Ocean Health Index and, with Heather Wrigley, provided its founding grant. Through the Ocean Health Council, he supported a project that brought business experience together with marine science, seeking a practical way to assess the seas.

The index combined ecological conditions with the benefits people receive from oceans, including food, livelihoods and coastal protection. At its launch, Wrigley wanted scientific evidence to reach people able to change ocean policy. Its country scores were designed to identify weaknesses and help governments and businesses compare the effects of different management choices.
